intro: Over a decade of building software and hardware systems, as a freelance consultant and as a researcher. I help colleges, start-ups and companies turn an idea in IoT, AI or education technology into a working system, and train the teams who will run it.

services.title: IoT & Li-Fi systems
services.desc: Sensor networks, smart-device prototypes and visible-light (Li-Fi) communication, from proof of concept to a working pilot.
services.proof: Ph.D. in Li-Fi for indoor IoT · Li-Fi patent granted in India and South Africa

services.title: AI, ML & computer vision
services.desc: Models and prototypes that turn images and sensor data into decisions: recognition, monitoring and prediction.
services.proof: Best Paper, IEEE AIC 2024 (sign-language recognition) · Best Project, Aavishkar 2017 (crop-health drone)

services.title: Full-stack platforms
services.desc: Web and mobile platforms built end to end, with the MERN stack, cloud and serverless back ends, designed to be easy to maintain.
services.proof: Built Student Hub: notes, animations and a sandboxed C autograder

services.title: AR / VR & digital twins
services.desc: Immersive learning and visualisation, and digital twins that mirror a physical system for monitoring and simulation.
services.proof: Teaches AR/VR at MIT-WPU · research on digital twins in healthcare

services.title: Healthcare IoT & informatics
services.desc: Connected-care and health-data systems, grounded in the latest research.
services.proof: Post-doctoral research at the University of Central Florida · four journal papers in 2025

services.title: Training & workshops
services.desc: Faculty development programmes, corporate training and hands-on workshops in IoT, full-stack development, AR/VR and applied AI.
services.proof: 12 years of teaching · Wipro Global Java Trainer certification

cases.title: Student Hub
cases.desc: A learning platform for Data Structures in C: syllabus-aligned notes, 47 interactive animations, quizzes, explainer videos and an autograder that runs student code in a sandbox, with a teacher dashboard.

cases.title: Li-Fi secured Wi-Fi access for on-campus exams
cases.desc: Uses Li-Fi to control Wi-Fi access during online exams on campus. Granted in South Africa (2023) and India (2024).

cases.title: Advhan: crowd-sourced road-health monitoring
cases.desc: Road conditions reported by the crowd and mapped in the cloud.

cases.title: DIY Rainwater Harvesting Advisor
cases.desc: A funded project (₹1,50,000, 2016) to help households plan their own rainwater harvesting.

process.desc: We talk through the problem, the users and what success looks like.
A written plan with milestones, timeline and cost.
Working versions you can try along the way, not one big reveal at the end.
Documentation, source code and training for the people who will run it.
